description: Metabase connector (read-only). Surfaces Metabase dashboards — name, description, collection, creator, archived flag, card count, created/updated timestamps — into the local index as `metabase:dashboard` items, with the dashboard's collection name resolved from a single `GET /api/collection` call. Metabase API-key auth (sent as the `x-api-key` request header, NOT `Authorization`). Metabase has no universal SaaS host: the server host is supplied via the `metabase.url` vault key and added to the sandbox network list at spawn time by `phase3AddMetabaseMcp`, so the static manifest network list is intentionally empty. v1 indexes dashboards only — saved questions (cards) and collections-as-items are a deferred follow-up. No write tools.
author: Nimbus
